frontend_rework.evidence: Layout receipts are clean — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass (measurement-summary.json), and no truncation/overflow is visible at either viewport. Rwork is implied by: (1) the functional defect visible in the initial state — seeded anomaly never appears (screenshots 异常 0/24 · 转换 0 vs intent at stream.js:177; root at stream.js:207); (2) four a11y/type check failures requiring fixes; (3) minor counter inconsistency: header shows 转换 0 while the feed displays 5 seeded transition events (stream.js:220-227 bypasses the transitions++ at stream.js:152).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is addressed by mechanism on both halves. Traceability: inspector 变化追溯 panel with timestamped reverse-chronological history incl. threshold bands (index.html:55-57, app.js:276-294, 296-318), timestamped event feed with kind dots, per-tile Δ vs 60s ago (app.js:147-153). No-flicker: hysteresis state machine with 2% margin, 3s warn dwell, 3-consecutive-tick + 5s recovery (stream.js:118-142), fixed-grid-no-reflow with in-place value updates and 0.5s settling highlight (app.js:4-7, 133-145, style.css:168, 211-215), fixed-height strip so membership changes don't push the grid (style.css:79-86), aria-live=off (index.html:37), and an explicit 42s rect-stability self-check (?scenario=stability, app.js:515-528).

defects_observed: Seeded initial anomaly does not render: both screenshots show 异常 0/24 · 转换 0 and an anomaly strip with no chips, while stream.js:177-180 intends 队列积压 to load in warn and escalate to crit ~15s later; the envelope call at stream.js:207 evaluates dt = -i ≤ 0 so the seeded envelope is always zero — the brief's 'anomaly visible within a glance' is not demonstrated on the initial screen (tile shows 队列积压 121 条 ▼9.9%, normal).

Receipt failures a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json), consistent with pervasive 9-11.5px dim-gray text and ~24px controls throughout style.css.

Header counter reads 转换 0 while the event feed simultaneously displays 5 historical transitions — seeded events are pushed directly into events[] (stream.js:220-227) without passing through the setStatus counter (stream.js:152), a small coherence flaw in the evidence chain.
scores.overall_note: PulseWall is a faithful representation for the monitor×volatile-evidence-stream cell: 24 metric tiles (object = metric) grouped into four domains fill the single page at both 1280x860 and 1440x900, topped by a dedicated anomaly strip and paired with a persistent right rail holding a threshold-banded inspector and a timestamped event feed; a hysteresis state machine, fixed-grid in-place updates, and a 42s rect-stability self-check directly serve the acceptance seed of traceable changes without flicker (stream.js:118-142, app.js:515-528). Navigation is one surface deep and context-preserving, and the screen is understandable at a glance. The principal observable defect is that the seeded initial anomaly never appears — both screenshots show 异常 0/24 with an empty strip even though stream.js:177-180 intends the page to load with 队列积压 in warn (envelope call at stream.js:207 reduces to dt=-i≤0), so the brief's glance-anomaly success criterion is structurally provided but not demonstrated on the initial screen. The sanitized receipt shows clean layout (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation pass) but 4/4 a11y/type failures (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), consistent with the pervasive 9-11px dim text and compact controls in style.css; the receipt does not identify which elements failed, so severity beyond the check ids is not judgeable. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; these are model judgments, not human preference.
